## Description (first paragraph)

Routes token-heavy work to a **local Ollama model** (`qwen2.5-coder:32b`) via
`scripts/ask-ollama.mjs`. The heavy input — the ~27 MB system-viz graph, a
2000-line source file, a build-error dump — is processed in the subprocess
and discarded. Only the **compact answer** returns to the Claude context.
